title: warm wholesome brazilian shaggy tart
description: a fragrant and soothing dessert featuring the sweetness of applesauce and the crunch of toast, served in a vibrant talavera plate
instructions: preheat the oven to 180°c (350°f) and grease a 20cm (8in) tart pan with non-stick spray
crumble the toasted bread into fine pieces and set aside
mix the coconut oil, maple syrup, vanilla extract, and nutmeg powder in a medium bowl
add the crumbled bread, applesauce, and graham cracker to the bowl and stir until well combined
transfer the mixture to the prepared tart pan and smooth the top
bake for 35 minutes, or until the tart is golden brown and set
remove from the oven and let cool for 5 minutes before serving
serve warm in a vibrant talavera plate garnished with chopped nuts or dried fruit
